name: Sheffield
meta_description: Sheffield's beer scene: Kelham Island real ale pubs, the Sheffield Tap and Peak District brewery trips, with bookable tastings nearby.
intro_md:
Sheffield's claim to be one of England's great beer cities rests on solid foundations. Kelham Island, once a district of workshops and foundries, is now the heart of the city's drinking culture, with celebrated real ale pubs such as the Fat Cat and the Kelham Island Tavern pouring pints a few doors apart.

Local breweries including Abbeydale and Bradfield keep the cask tradition in good health, and the Sheffield Tap — a restored Edwardian refreshment room on the station platform — makes a memorable first pint in the city. Look out for Henderson's Relish too: the spicy Sheffield condiment appears on menus all over town.

The Peak District begins at the city's western edge, which puts Thornbridge's brewery in Bakewell within easy reach for a half-day trip of tastings and moorland air.

**Don't miss**

- A pint at the Fat Cat in Kelham Island
- The Sheffield Tap's restored Edwardian bar
- A trip to Thornbridge Brewery in Bakewell

gyg_tours.title: Bakewell: Thornbridge Brewery Tour & Beer Tasting Experience
gyg_tours.summary: A 45-minute guided tour of Thornbridge's Riverside brewery in Bakewell, home to the UK's only working Burton Union brewing set, finishing with a tasting of six beers in the taproom.
gyg_tours.description_md: Enjoy a 45-minute guided tour of Thornbridge Brewery, set on the edge of the Peak District in Bakewell. The experience takes place in the Taproom beside the original Hall brewery kit, home to the UK's only working Burton Union set, and begins with a short film on the brewery's history. A guide walks you through the brewing process before a tutored tasting of six selected beers, served as thirds, ranging from crisp lagers to hoppy IPAs and rich stouts. The tour is dog-friendly and ends in the Taproom, with a 10% discount on takeaway beers in the shop.
highlights: Taste six unique Thornbridge beers as thirds
See the UK's only working Burton Union set
Watch a short film on Thornbridge's heritage
gyg_tours.meeting_point: Thornbridge Brewery, Bakewell (arrive at least 15 minutes before your start time)

gyg_tours.title: Sheffield: Gin Distillery Tasting Visit with Guided Tour
gyg_tours.summary: A guided visit to Locksley Distilling Co. at Sheffield's historic Portland Works, with a look at the gin-making process and a tasting of the core range, including a gin and tonic.
gyg_tours.description_md: This 90-minute guided tour explores Locksley Distilling's operations inside Sheffield's historic Portland Works, a Grade II* listed building dating from 1879. Visitors get an intimate look at the small-batch gin production process and learn about the distillery's botanicals and their origins. The experience includes an expert-led tasting session covering the distillery's core range, along with a Locksley gin and tonic.
highlights: Guided tour of the working distillery
See small-batch gin production up close
Expert-led tasting of the core range
Learn about botanicals and their origins
Small groups of up to 10 people
gyg_tours.meeting_point: Outside the gate on the corner of Randall Street; the guide escorts you inside.
